purpose: Authoritative cipher-side row transcription of the Kryptos sculpture, rows 1-28, as supplied in docs/external/checkpoint-K-nsa-cipher-rows-1-24.md and verified here.

provenance.primary: CIA legacy page, 'Kryptos' Sculpture, Panel 1 - Encoded Text (Text Version), https://www.cia.gov/legacy/headquarters/kryptos-sculpture
provenance.corroborating: NSA DOCID 4145036 cipher-side slide; NSA DOCID 4145037 summary
provenance.grade: A for row text and row order. NOT a measured fabrication survey: it establishes no horizontal coordinate, no inter-character spacing and no vertical character-centre alignment.

verification.uniform_31_arithmetic: 32 + 27*31 = 869 gives the right TOTAL but is a FALSE description of the row structure: rows 1-24 range from 29 to 33 characters. Superseded.
independent_corroborations: rows 15-25 up to and including the terminal '?' contain 337 characters, i.e. exactly 336 letters, matching the standard K3 ciphertext length
row 25 after its '?' is exactly OBKR, and rows 26-28 equal K4[4:35], K4[35:66], K4[66:97] from data/k4.json, so K4 = 4 + 93 = 97
row 1 is the canonical K1 ciphertext opening EMUFPHZLRFAXYUSDJKZLDKRNSHGNFIVJ and row 15 the canonical K3 ciphertext opening ENDYAHROHNLSRHEO...

resolved_correction.issue: Rows 1-14 were once described as a 432-vs-435 discrepancy.
resolved_correction.resolution: RESOLVED: 435 counts physical ciphertext characters; 432 are letters and 3 are '?' separators. The earlier comparison mixed units.
resolved_correction.caution: This resolution does not settle separate questions about intended pre-aesthetic K2 text, omitted X handling, or physical horizontal geometry.

alignment.note: No horizontal coordinate is established by this source. Row-local character index MUST NOT be treated as a physical column. See docs/exp035-preregistration.md for the finite family of alignment conventions that is preregistered instead, and docs/external-evidence-requests.md Request 4 for the evidence that would settle it.
